title: 第十八章 重力加速度与扫地的关系第十七章 外门第九百零一号杂役
lines: 章节摘要：“同样是一桶水，你用力泼出去，和让它沿斜面自然流淌，消耗的力气差三倍。废土拾荒者，天生懂得省力。“——牛顿
第二天的任务单上写着：挑水。
天道院的饮用灵泉在主峰峰顶，那是内门才能接触的资源。杂役用的水源，是半山腰的一口普通水井——灵气含量和废土雨水差不多，但至少是干净的。每天要从井里挑水，送到外门各处的储水点，用于清扫、灌溉、喂兽，单程两百米，高差十一米，每次两桶，规定十趟。
别的杂役挑得很辛苦。
宁修远挑了两趟，换了路线。
山腰有一块突出的岩石，位置在水井和储水点之间的三分之一处，大多数杂役绕着走——多走几步。但宁修远在第一趟的时候，已经用ui把这段路的地形测绘了一遍。
那块岩石，恰好在坡度最陡的那段路的起点，形成了一个天然的支点。
他第三趟出发的时候，把扁担的重心向前移了约四厘米，经过岩石时让扁担后端轻轻借了一下力，整个动作不到两秒，但把后半段上坡最费力的区间，变成了一个缓释的杠杆过程：
[杠杆借力·受力分析]
[原始路线：直线上坡·肌肉持续承担100%桶重]
[优化路线：岩石支点·瞬时载荷降低31%]
[能耗对比：节省约34%体力消耗·可维持更长时间连续挑运]
他比别的杂役快了将近四分钟。
赵福在第五趟的时候发现了。
他站在高处，盯着宁修远的背影看了整整半趟路，什么都没看出来——就是走，就是挑，路线比别人稍微绕一点，但速度更快，扁担更稳，到了储水点，桶里的水几乎没有洒。
赵福盯了他很久，最后走开了，什么都没说。
牛顿在宁修远脑海里，用一种点评学生作业的语气说：
“同样是一桶水，你用力泼出去，和让它沿斜面自然流淌，消耗的力气差三倍。废土拾荒者，天生懂得省力。“
停顿。
“这不是懒，这是对能量守恒的本能理解。“
与此同时，叶清欢正在整理一叠发黄的典籍。
她的房间比宁修远好很多——独立小间，有窗户，朝南，采光充足。任务是把金星宗委托代管的古籍进行分类，既是掩护，也让她合法地接触了大量天道院内部文献。
她的“清音“人设：寒系灵体，性格冷僻，话少，不喜社交。
问题在于，“不喜欢社交“和“从未学会社交“，看起来是一样的冷漠，但形成原因完全不同。叶清欢属于后者，但结果完美符合人设——她天生就这样，甚至不需要刻意维持。
外门有几个弟子对她感兴趣。
金星宗挂靠弟子，实力不明，住单间，不用跟人挤，这在外门区域已经是某种地位的象征，加上她站在书架旁边整理典籍的样子，有一种很难被忽视的安静。
其中一个叫周然，练气八层，自我感觉在外门弟子里已经算高阶，说话向来有些漫不经心。
他在叶清欢整理典籍的走廊里来回转了两圈，最终停在她旁边，倚着书架，问了一句：
“清音师妹，你有没有……心动过？“
叶清欢把手里那本典籍翻到下一页，看了三秒，然后抬起眼，平静地看着他。
周然以为她在酝酿什么，微微向前靠了一点。
叶清欢开口，语气非常平：
周然一愣。
“依据当前记录——在某个特定个体五米范围内，我的核心运行效率比基准值高约3.7%，信息处理循环增加约12%，且在非威胁场景下会产生优先保护该个体的指向性判断，该状态目前持续存在。“
她歪了一下头：
“如果这符合你所定义的'心动'，答案是肯定的。“
周然站在那里，嘴动了一下，发现自己没有任何合适的回应。
他清了清嗓子，说了句“哦……那挺好的“，找了个理由，走了。
此后，他见到叶清欢，会提前换一条路。
叶清欢把那本典籍合上，放回正确位置，继续整理下一本。
第三天，铁翎鹰。
灵兽区最里侧，笼门上挂着一块手写的牌：进入前需报备，无故不入，受伤自负。

Chapter summary: "It is the same bucket of water. If you throw it out with force, it will consume three times less energy than letting it flow naturally along the slope. Wasteland scavengers are born to know how to save effort." - Newton
The task list for the next day read: carry water.
The drinking spring of Tiandaoyuan is at the top of the main peak, which is a resource that can only be accessed by the inner sect. The water source used by handymen is an ordinary well halfway up the mountain - the spiritual energy content is about the same as rainwater in the wasteland, but at least it is clean. Every day, water must be fetched from the well and delivered to water storage points at various locations outside the gate for cleaning, irrigation, and animal feeding. The one-way trip is 200 meters, with a height difference of 11 meters. Two buckets are required each time, and ten trips are required.
Other handymen have a hard time choosing.
Ning Xiuyuan took two trips and changed the route.
There is a rocky outcrop on the mountainside, one-third of the way between the well and the water storage site, that most handymen walk around - and take a few steps. But Ning Xiuyuan had already used UI to map the topography of this section of the road during his first trip.
That rock formed a natural fulcrum just at the beginning of the steepest section of the road.
When he set out for the third time, he moved the center of gravity of the pole forward about four centimeters, and when passing the rocks, he let the back end of the pole lend a slight force. The whole action took less than two seconds, but turned the most strenuous section of the second half of the uphill climb into a slow-release lever process:
[Leverage and force analysis]
[Original route: Straight uphill·Muscles continue to bear 100% of the barrel weight]
[Optimized route: rock fulcrum·instantaneous load reduced by 31%]
[Energy consumption comparison: Save about 34% of physical energy consumption, and can maintain continuous transportation for a longer time]
He was nearly four minutes faster than the other handymen.
Zhao Fu discovered it on the fifth trip.
He stood on a high place and stared at Ning Xiuyuan's back for the entire half of the journey without seeing anything - just walking and picking. The route was a little rounder than others, but the speed was faster and the pole was more stable. When he arrived at the water storage point, the water in the bucket was almost not spilled.
Zhao Fu stared at him for a long time and finally walked away without saying anything.
In Ning Xiuyuan's mind, Newton said in a tone like he was commenting on a student's homework:
"For the same bucket of water, if you throw it out with force, it will consume three times less energy than if you let it flow naturally along the slope. Wasteland scavengers naturally know how to save effort."
Pause.
"This is not laziness, this is an instinctive understanding of energy conservation."
At the same time, Ye Qinghuan was sorting out a stack of yellowed classics.
Her room was much better than Ning Xiuyuan's - a small independent room with windows, facing south and getting plenty of light. The task was to classify the ancient books entrusted by the Jinxing Sect. This not only served as a cover, but also gave her legal access to a large number of Tiandao Academy's internal documents.
Her "voiceless" persona: cold spirit, withdrawn, talks little, and doesn't like to socialize.
The problem is that "not liking socializing" and "never learning to socialize" may seem the same indifference, but the causes are completely different. Ye Qinghuan belongs to the latter, but the result perfectly fits the character - she is born like this and does not even need to deliberately maintain it.
Several disciples from the outer sect were interested in her.
She is an affiliated disciple of the Jinxing Sect and her strength is unknown. She lives in a single room and does not have to squeeze in with others. This is already a status symbol in the outer gate area. Plus, the way she is standing next to the bookshelf sorting out the classics, there is a quietness that is hard to ignore.
One of them, named Zhou Ran, was at the eighth level of Qi training. He felt that he was already a high-level disciple among the outer disciples, and he always spoke a little carelessly.
He walked back and forth twice in the corridor where Ye Qinghuan was sorting the classics, and finally stopped next to her, leaned against the bookshelf, and asked:
"Junior Sister Qingyin, have you ever... felt your heart flutter?"
Ye Qinghuan turned the book in his hand to the next page, looked at it for three seconds, then raised his eyes and looked at him calmly.
Zhou Ran thought she was brewing something and leaned forward slightly.
Ye Qinghuan spoke in a very calm tone:
"Yes."
Zhou Ran was stunned.
"Based on current records - within five meters of a specific individual, my core operating efficiency is approximately 3.7% higher than the baseline value, and the information processing cycle increases by approximately 12%. In non-threatening scenarios, a directional judgment will be made to prioritize protecting the individual. This state currently continues to exist."
She tilted her head:
"If this fits your definition of 'heartbeat,' the answer is yes."
Zhou Ran stood there, moved his mouth, and found that he didn't have any suitable response.
He cleared his throat, said "Oh...that's good", found an excuse, and left.
After that, when he saw Ye Qinghuan, he would change his path in advance.
Ye Qinghuan closed the classic book, put it back in its correct position, and continued to organize the next one.
On the third day, the iron-feathered eagle.
At the far end of the spirit animal area, there is a handwritten sign hanging on the cage door: You need to report before entering. If you don't enter without any reason, you will be responsible for any injury.
